audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart says Kayle wins Levels 2 and 3 and 'Skill' at Level 1 / 4-5, while the why text on those same rows says Karma chunks a 175-range melee with no waveclear and no mobility.
audit.why: Kayle has no dash, no waveclear and 175 attack range until her level-11 ranged form; Karma out-ranges her 950 to 175 and has Mantra from level 1. The rows contradicted their own explanations.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 set to Karma in both layers; rows 5-6 stay Kayle, which is where her scaling actually takes the lane and matches the 43.48% win rate.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 row was boilerplate ('no new ultimate at 6... his spike') and never said what Divine Judgment does or costs.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s and grants invulnerability only — it is not a lane-threat spike; Kayle's real spike is level 11 ranged form.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why rewritten with the 160s cooldown and the fact that it is defensive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions absent: Celestial Blessing (W) heals her on a flat 15s, and Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto-attack reset scaling on missing health.
audit.why: Kit flags: W heal, E autoReset with 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 cooldown. The heal decides extended trades against chip poke; the E reset means the burst tell is the auto wind-up, not a cast animation.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds timing added to the Do's, auto-reset tell added to the Don'ts.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Divine Judgment at 6 is defensive invulnerability, not range — bait the 160-second ult, then keep poking a melee Kayle.

edits.before: Kayle burns Divine Judgment (Invuln) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Celestial Blessing heals her every 15s — bring Grievous Wounds before any long trade.

edits.before: That is Kayle’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Starfire Spellblade's auto wind-up is the tell — step back on it, not on her cast.

edits.before: Track Kayle’s Divine Judgment (Invuln): Invulnerability denies your execute — bait it, then kill. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 and only grants invulnerability — bait it, then restart poke; her autos stay melee until level 11.
